stories.title: Jio Platforms announces Rs 30,213 crore IPO, valuation above Rs 10 lakh crore
stories.summary: Jio Platforms disclosed a primary equity offering of Rs 30,213 crore, aiming for a post‑issue valuation exceeding Rs 10 lakh crore. The filing describes the issue as the largest public offering ever recorded in India. The source does not provide specific dates, price band, or guaranteed minimum price details.
stories.why: The unprecedented size may reshape market liquidity and set a new benchmark for large listings in India.

stories.title: India’s unemployment rate unchanged at 5% in September 2026
stories.summary: India’s overall unemployment rate held steady at 5.0% in September 2026, unchanged from the previous month. Rural unemployment improved to 4.2%, while urban unemployment rose slightly to 6.9%; urban female unemployment increased to 9.2%. The Labour Force Participation Rate rose to 55.5% year‑on‑year and the Worker Population Ratio increased to 52.7%.
stories.why: The figures indicate a stable national job market but rising pressure in urban labour pools, which is relevant for policymakers and investors.

stories.title: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
stories.summary: A search and rescue operation involving boats and helicopters is now continuing in rough seas, Romania's authorities say Seven of 12 crew members are missing after a drone attack left a chemical tanker ablaze off Romania's coast on Thursday morning, naval authorities say. Romanian President Nicușor Dan confirmed that the Wine Trader and another chemical tanker in the area, the Yara J, had both been struck by drones - the Yara J on Wednesday.

stories.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
stories.summary: Thousands of students have taken to the streets in the Albanian capital of Tirana, attacking several government buildings on the second day of violent anti-government protests. Albania's Deputy Prime Minister ​Albana Koçiu has called for "calmness, self-restraint and maturity" and said "Albania does not need to burn to change".
